invariants.name: jwt_or_oidc_auth
invariants.description: protected paths validate JWT/OIDC bearer identity

invariants.name: auth_check_delegation
invariants.description: non-auth services delegate authorization to auth-service via POST /api/v1/auth/check; never re-validate JWT locally

invariants.name: dlq_replay_flow
invariants.description: dead-letter entries support controlled replay/discard recovery flows

invariants.name: no_api_key
invariants.pattern: jwt-only auth|api key fields removed|api key auth superseded
invariants.description: authentication is JWT/OIDC only (DMS-146); API key support removed and must not be re-introduced

invariants.name: s2s_azp_restriction
invariants.description: service-to-service endpoints restrict callers by azp JWT claim; every permitted caller must be explicitly allowlisted

invariants.name: pii_fernet_encryption
invariants.description: PII fields stored encrypted with Fernet key chains and blind-index lookups
